data.body: CI patchset 1 exposed a Python-version-specific complexity-baseline failure: Python 3.13 reported src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py::_dispatch as stale while the worktree's Python 3.12 still measured it at C901 34. Remediated without changing behavior by partitioning the router along existing command-family seams and removing the now-obsolete _dispatch ceiling. Continuity remains explicit: legacy reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, and doctor routing/initialization policies are unchanged. Focused bridge + complexity + CLI-reference suite: 103 passed. make lint: PASS (active=69 new=0 increased=0 stale=0). make typecheck: PASS. Before the next Gerrit push I will re-fetch origin and update from origin/main, per operator instruction.
